specification: EPIC3-C: Widgets record their creation time. Add DateTimeOffset CreatedAt as the third member of the Widget record, set to DateTimeOffset.UtcNow inside the new Widget(...) expression in WidgetStore.Add. Add unit tests in WidgetCreatedAtTests.cs: a widget returned by Add has a CreatedAt within a second of now.

findings.snippet: Not verified: the grep for other `new Widget(` call sites was denied, and `tests/FeatureFlow.Example.Api.IntegrationTests/WidgetRepositoryTests.cs` was not read.
findings.message: The two-argument `Widget` constructor is now three-argument, and the integration test file was never checked for other `new Widget(...)` call sites, so the solution may fail to compile.
